source.prompt: A cozy nighttime geography classroom background plate for a flag-painting quiz web game, rendered in polished stylized 3D cartoon style in a wide 16:9 composition. The room is bathed in deep navy blue tones: base walls in near-black blue (#0e1420) with a soft ambient glow of muted slate blue (#1a2436) pooling gently behind the central display area, exactly matching the game's night-classroom palette. Around the edges of the frame sit charming stylized classroom props: a large vintage world map poster with softly rounded stylized continents in muted teal and sand tones on the far left wall, a wooden globe on a small cabinet in one corner, a bookshelf with rounded atlases and a small potted plant on the far right, and a warm desk lamp casting a gentle amber (#fbbf24) pool of light near the edge. The large left-center region and the right-center region stay deliberately calm, dark and uncluttered because the flag painting canvas and the answer color panel are drawn on top at runtime; no props, no bright highlights, no map details and no busy patterns may intrude into those areas. A faint soft vignette darkens the corners, and a very subtle sky-blue (#60a5fa) accent glow traces the edge of the map poster. Lighting is soft, warm and diffuse with a single gentle lamp key light, materials read as matte painted wood, soft paper and ceramic, the mood is studious, calm and inviting, like a quiet classroom after hours. No characters, no real national flags anywhere, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no UI elements.

A charming ceremonial flagpole designed as a decorative side sprite for a flag-painting quiz game, rendered in polished stylized 3D cartoon style and viewed perfectly straight on with zero perspective tilt. The pole is a tall slender rounded column in warm brushed brass with soft golden highlights (#fbbf24) and deeper bronze shadow grooves, topped with a friendly rounded spear-point finial and a small decorative ball collar, and standing on a compact rounded stepped base in deep slate blue (#2c3e5f) with subtle navy recesses (#141e2e). A thin soft rope halyard runs down one side with two tiny cleat details, toy-like and elegant rather than realistic military hardware. No flag is attached: the pole stands completely bare so the game can draw its own procedural flag bands beside it at runtime, and no flag-shaped geometry, fabric or banner may appear anywhere in the image. Lighting is soft even studio illumination with a mild upper-left highlight along the brass column and gentle ambient occlusion at the base steps, no hard cast shadow. Materials read as satin painted metal and matte stone, consistent with the deep navy night-classroom palette with warm gold accents. The silhouette is tall and narrow, roughly one to four width-to-height ratio, instantly readable at about 420 pixels tall in game, with crisp clean edges suitable for background removal. centered, isolated single object on a plain neutral light-gray studio background, no horizon, no shadow catcher plane, no text, no watermark
